item.description: It’s 2026, and the city is still begging for basic drinking water Here we are in 2026, and yet Guwahati continues to wait for what should have been a basic civic guarantee: regular, safe piped water in every household. item.title: Me-Dam-Me-Phi: Preserving an Ancient Ancestral Faith in a Modern World
item.description: Not many people outside Assam are familiar with Me-Dam-Me-Phi, a deeply spiritual and historically significant festival of the Tai-Ahom community. Observed every year on January 31, the festival is not merely a ritual—it is a living bridge between the present and a civilisation that has endured for centuries.
